cyberattack: Bypassing bot protection or access controls
data.description:
Addendum to existing finding #55: that finding documents committee-detail HTML responses. This adds a different PDF-generator endpoint and a verified five-page filing, paired with a rejection from the ordinary route three seconds earlier. The general suffix-workaround technique is already recorded.

On May 26, 2026, Arquivo preserved a sequence of path-shape experiments against California's CAL-ACCESS campaign-finance service. At 14:45:30 UTC the ordinary PDF-generator route for filing 2921206, amendment 1 returned HTTP 200 but only a 1,056-byte Incapsula rejection page. At 14:45:33, the same query parameters and order on the route with an appended PDF-looking path returned a valid 34,559-byte, five-page California Form 461 amendment. Both historical bodies were checked against their exact archive timestamps and indexed digests.

The retrieved document covers January-June 2024 and reports $89,600 in contributions/expenditures. Those figures identify public document contents, not the requester. A separate committee-detail comparison shows a normal route returning an Incapsula rejection and a suffixed route returning genuine campaign-finance HTML. That comparison is more than an hour apart and is weaker causal evidence. Across the selected history, 17 captures covering 16 exact URLs append PDF, image, stylesheet or other path endings; HTTP 200 alone is insufficient to count any one of them as a successful document retrieval.

The verified rejection/PDF pair is strong practical evidence of obtaining public data through an altered URL shape during a sequence that encountered filtering. The bypass category describes this workaround. It does not establish that the suffix alone caused the difference: original request headers, source IP, cookies and intervening session conditions are not available. No authentication bypass, nonpublic filing access, SQL injection, arbitrary filesystem read or command execution is demonstrated.

The submitter, authorization context and any AI involvement remain unknown. These are May historical events, not September operations when the evidence was reviewed. Untapped source is No for the bounded finding: the specific paired outcome is verified, and a larger unexamined related corpus is not claimed here.
data.summary: California CAL-ACCESS returned a real five-page public filing through a suffixed path three seconds after the normal route returned a rejection page. This supports a retrieval workaround, not protected-data access.
